facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on LA-7201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 29 August 2025 a planned assurance activity of LA-7201 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment not effective.
